text: Claude ke chaar levels hain, aur zyada tar business owners Level one pe hi atke hain. Aap kaunse level pe ho? Dekhte hain. Level one: Chat. Sawaal poocha, jawab copy kiya. Bas. Level two: Projects. Apni price list, FAQs aur brand ki tone ek baar Project mein daal do. Ab har jawab aapke business ki bhasha mein aata hai. Level three: Connectors. Gmail, Calendar aur Drive jodo. Ab Claude khud emails padh ke reply draft karta hai, aur meeting calendar mein daal deta hai. Aur bhejne se pehle aapse poochta hai. Level four: Scheduled tasks. Ek baar bolo: har subah nine baje kal ki saari enquiries ki summary bhejo. Aur ye roz apne aap hota hai, laptop band ho tab bhi. Yahan Claude chatbot nahi, aapka assistant ban jaata hai. Har level ka setup aur ready prompts maine ek free guide mein daal diye hain. Chahiye to follow karo aur comment karo LEVEL. Guide seedha aapke DM mein. Toh channel ke description mein di gayi link se hamara WhatsApp channel join kar lo.
